title: Fix slug generation for separators and diacritics
instruction: src/slug.mjs exports slugify(title). Fix it so that it: lowercases; reduces Latin letters with diacritics to their base letters (for example 'é' becomes 'e'); replaces every run of characters other than a-z and 0-9 with a single '-'; and removes leading and trailing '-'. An input without letters or digits returns ''. Keep the export name and signature.

acceptanceCriteria: runs of separators collapse to one '-'
diacritics are reduced to base letters
